subject.title: fix: OpenAI-compatible provider compat and error-body surfacing

question: Should `packages/ai` disable OpenAI SDK retries by default for every consumer, or should zero retries be applied only at the OpenClaw runtime boundary?
rationale: Both choices can be technically valid, but they define different compatibility and availability contracts for consumers that omit `maxRetries`; repository history and tests cannot establish the intended public package policy.

options.title: Confirm zero-retry package contract
options.body: Keep the new shared default, then prove and document that OpenClaw or each supported consumer owns retry and failover above the provider transport.

options.title: Scope zero retries to OpenClaw
options.body: Preserve the shared package's existing inherited retry behavior and pass `maxRetries: 0` from the OpenClaw runtime where the outer retry policy is guaranteed.

recommendation.title: Confirm zero-retry package contract
recommendation.body: Keep the new shared default, then prove and document that OpenClaw or each supported consumer owns retry and failover above the provider transport.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available history in the shared AI package and authored the current retry-policy consolidation.
